svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ESAF standalone, with its own hub
svg.desc: The AI Factory creates its own hub in its Dev network, with a VPN gateway, a DNS resolver and Bastion. The private DNS zones live in the common resource group. The image also shows Microsoft 365 with Teams and Copilot, which reach a Foundry agent through Bot Service; Microsoft Power Platform with Copilot Studio and Power Automate, which reach the common virtual network; SharePoint and Microsoft Fabric as knowledge and data for Foundry IQ and the Fabric data agent tool; and API Management or Kong as the AI gateway. Every Azure resource of the resource library is on the image, in the project resource group or in the common resource group. Numbered blue circles mark the code template for each part.
svg.text: ESAF standalone, with its own hub

text.tspan: The AI Factory creates its own hub in its Dev network, with a VPN gateway, a DNS resolver and Bastion. The private DNS zones live in the common resource group.

svg.text: A numbered circle is a code template: select it, or find it in the table below the image. A dashed line is a private connection.
Knowledge and data outside the Factory
People who work in the Factory

text.tspan: The Factory needs no other hub.
Each Factory pays for its own VPN gateway.

svg.text: AI Factory · scale set 001 · Dev subscription (Stage and Prod have the same layout)
Project resource group · one for each team (project 001, 002, ...)
Agent service keeps its data here
Project subnets · in the common virtual network

text.tspan: The services of a project are reached through private endpoints.
Each service runs with a managed identity of the project.
The project VM is private: reach it through Bastion or the VPN.
Azure Backup keeps the admin VM and the project VMs.
Defender for AI watches each AI resource of the project.

svg.text: Common resource group · shared by the projects of the scale set

text.tspan: Private DNS zones are in this resource group. Peering connects this network to the own hub.
A new project gets its own subnets from the address range of this network.
Defender for Cloud covers the whole subscription,
with the plans for AI and Key Vault.
One endpoint in front of a pool of model deployments, with retries.
The Foundry account can also have its own AI gateway (new SKU): enableAIGatewaySKU.

Bot Service passes each message to the agent
